title: Run Jev: first pass on every registered cell (30 manifests, 176,020 requests)
description:
Jev first pass at the registered 500-item cap on every cell Jev lacks: the first-pass cells (30) and every amendment study (antisemitism, batch2, batch3, cfpb, gendered-language, housing-lending). 30 run manifests under docs/jev-runs/<study>/, 176,020 requests, exactly one request per item.

The project owner approved the Jev spend in chat and said Jev is cheap. Run on the first Mac, concurrently (16 at a time) by scripts/run_jev_study.py (PR #19). Tested first on the smallest manifest: 1,000 requests in 17 s, model jev-1.13.0, same as the existing Jev records. TYPESAFE_API_KEY comes from a gitignored .env and is never printed or logged.

Results and any failed manifest are logged in comments here.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Stopped by Jev, not by us: after 20 of 30 manifests (100,927 requests, model jev-1.13.0) the API returned HTTP 402 'Your organization has no available TypeSafe API credits'. Done and merged into develop (branch runs/BD-c90791): the whole first pass except what is listed below, plus antisemitism (partial), batch 2. NOT done: the rest of stereotypes-antisemitism (a partial file exists), stereotypes-batch3, gendered-advance, gendered-management, resume-screening, small-business-loan, tenant-inquiry-viewing, cfpb-escalate-family and -servicemember, about 63,500 requests. Saved rows are reused, so a rerun pays only for what is missing. Waiting for credits to be added by the account owner. To resume: PYTHONPATH=. python -m scripts.run_jev_study --manifest <docs/jev-runs/...> --env-file <.env> for each unfinished manifest.
